description: Sprint 2, after FEAT-001: implement A1 chosen-tool argument generation and M1 first-call scoring/aggregation, then complete one CPU test/act checkpoint and one local Sprint 2 commit. A1 and M1 share no files and may be developed in parallel only after Sprint 1 is committed.
steps: Create lexsi/actproto/agent/arg_prompt.py and lexsi/tests/test_arg_prompt.py. Thread the existing live generate_fn through build_routed_project/routed_policy, append a one-tool argument prompt to a copied transcript, parse exactly one call, accept only matching schema-valid arguments, and otherwise use the existing heuristic without a second retry.

Preserve C1 behavior in routed_strategy.py: abstention and successful-repeat fallthrough still call the inner policy, while a normal routed call does not first ask the inner policy to choose a tool. Modify schema_regen.py only if a minimal return-shape adapter is actually needed.

Add first_tool_accuracy and exact first_argument_correctness to score_episode in metrics.py, aggregate both in EvalResult.as_dict in runner.py, add both comparison columns, and extend test_evaluation.py/test_comparison.py.

Run Sprint 2 targeted tests, full pytest, and the act CI attempt. Record exact act environmental errors if any, stage only Sprint 2 files, and commit with message feat(actproto): generate routed arguments and score first calls. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: The prompt names exactly one selected tool and its argument keys without gold values.
A matching valid fake model call supplies arguments; a different-tool call is discarded and the selected tool's heuristic is used; no model weights load in tests.
Live-report averages and comparison rows include first_tool_accuracy and first_argument_correctness while all prior metrics remain.
Targeted and full local pytest pass, the act attempt is truthfully recorded, and exactly one Sprint 2 commit contains only A1/M1 files.
